description: Retain graph-selected process traces as verified reusable strategy evidence.

microtheory.name: strategy_discovery
microtheory.description: Learn strategies from witnessed task outcomes.

rules.name: sd_start_witnessed_size_lift
rules.comment: Start a new-size strategy only when process_lifting has produced an exact native-verified instance from two size witnesses.

rules.name: sd_start_lifted_strategy
rules.comment: Reuse a verified ordered strategy under a different state binding; each process is still applied and checked by the native step rule.

rules.name: sd_start_matching_strategy
rules.comment: Replay a verified graph trace only for a new task with the same domain, initial state, goal and epochs.

rules.name: sd_apply_witnessed_size_lift_step
rules.comment: Apply the exact process-lifting instance through native ProcessApply and retain the target-size trace.

rules.name: sd_apply_matching_strategy_step
rules.comment: Apply one witnessed process with the native evaluator and keep the executed trace on the task.

rules.name: sd_record_failed_strategy_binding
rules.comment: Retain a replay failure as a binding-specific constraint so the same strategy is not retried blindly.

rules.name: sd_record_world_receipted_strategy
rules.comment: Retain a strategy only when a solved graph trace is linked to an exact verified native-process world receipt.

rules.name: sd_record_solved_trace
rules.comment: Retain a strategy only from a completed task trace of graph-held processes.
